title: Oracle: 'Existential risk' of underspending is worse than overspending
title_zh: 甲骨文：支出不足的“生存风险”比超支更严重
summary: Oracle (ORCL) reported fourth quarter results on Wednesday after the closing bell. Adjusted earnings per share (EPS) came in at $2.11 (compared to analyst estimates of $1.97), and adjusted revenue came in at $19.18 billion (compared to analyst estimates of $19.09 billion).
summary_zh: 甲骨文（ORCL）周三收盘后公布了第四季度业绩。调整后每股收益 (EPS) 为 2.11 美元（分析师预期为 1.97 美元），调整后营收为 191.8 亿美元（分析师预期为 190.9 亿美元）。

title: Oracle's AI spending blows past estimates, raising worries over growing debt
title_zh: 甲骨文的人工智能支出超出预期，引发对不断增长的债务的担忧
summary: Oracle on Wednesday forecast capital spending plans for fiscal 2027 above Wall Street estimates, as the cloud computing company said it will also raise more debt in 2027, reflecting the staggering scale of cash ‌burn needed to build out its AI infrastructure.
summary_zh: 甲骨文周三预测 2027 财年的资本支出计划将高于华尔街的预期，这家云计算公司表示还将在 2027 年筹集更多债务，反映出建设其人工智能基础设施所需的现金消耗规模惊人。
